title: Move the quest/lore pair from 0.14.2 to 0.15.0: mark the agents --check exit-code change breaking (ODOC-556 ruling OA-r354-pair-0142-semver)
description: opum-doc ruled 2026-10-31 (ODOC-556, OA-r354-pair-0142-semver, option A): the pair ships as 0.15.0, not 0.14.2. CD-1 (docs/standards/deployment-releases-and-environments.md) counts breaking by what a caller built against and names a remapped exit code; `agents --check` going from exit 0 to 6 on an unchanged Codex-only or Antigravity workspace is breaking for anyone running it in CI. CD-3: a breaking change MUST be labelled in the CHANGELOG, and either repository breaking marker forces the pair to at least minor. So the CHANGELOG entry carries the breaking marker the breaking_bump gate reads (a `### ... (breaking)` heading), keeping the upgrade step (run quest agents --update-instructions, then delete the old-path skill file by hand), and the gate then enforces the minor bump itself. #706 landed at 0.14.2 (squash 002f53ba); this task changes every 0.14.2 declaration to 0.15.0, renames the CHANGELOG heading, and rebuilds the six binaries. lore-check.yml is NOT pinned here until lore-cli#702 has a new head at 0.15.0 (the leader sends that SHA; a later commit, fence: CI workflow). QCLI-328 gap (the gate keys only on the heading, so an unlabelled break passes) is information only, not filed.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every 0.14.2 version declaration #706 set reads 0.15.0: package.json and its six optionalDependencies, the six npm/quest-*/package.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, src/application/version.ts, src/contract/tracker/index.ts, fixtures/tracker/v1/conformance.json, bun.lock pins, and the CLAUDE.md managed-block version
The six platform binaries are rebuilt at 0.15.0 and every questBinarySha256 and the questPlatformPackages map match the bytes (check:packages, check:lockfile and test:packages exit 0)

CHANGELOG has ## 0.15.0 with a ### ... (breaking) heading carrying the Codex/Antigravity agents --check change and its upgrade step; check-breaking-bump goes red at 0.14.x and green at 0.15.0 over the same notes
lore-check.yml is pinned to lore 0.15.0 and lore-cli#702 new head by ref, and lore check is green on the final head
The pair lands under fresh Opus review at the final heads of both repositories
